sources.quote: Context caching price Not available $0.025 (text / image / video) $0.05 (audio) $1.00 / 1,000,000 tokens per hour (storage price)
sources.supports: Google lists context caching at $0.025 per million text/image/video tokens and separately labels $1.00 per million tokens per hour as storage price; this matches the disputed 1.0 amount as storage, not a per-token cache-write price.

sources.quote: Input price Free of charge $0.25 (text / image / video) $0.50 (audio)
sources.supports: Google's listed Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite paid input price is $0.25 per million tokens for text, image, and video.

sources.quote: Output price (including thinking tokens) Free of charge $1.50
sources.supports: Google's listed Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite paid output price is $1.50 per million tokens.
Google dates the Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite general availability announcement to May 7, 2026; the models.dev earlier record begins that same date.

notes: The disputed $1.00 corresponds to Google's separately identified hourly storage charge, while the provider's pricing row gives a $0.025 context caching token rate and does not state a distinct $1.00 cache-write token price. The Wayback CDX request returned HTTP 503, so no archived snapshot pair was available to establish a precise historical boundary.
